svg.title: Same start. Different motion.
svg.desc: A same-start, low-speed Crossing example from the 270-episode TIB-3 batch. Both configurations succeeded. Two top-down plots show recorded robot and obstacle paths at the same spatial scale; the bottom panel shows signed robot forward velocity against recorded step, without converting steps into seconds. IRC-RS has 155 samples, the PPO comparison has 63. Arrows show the direction of movement. The figure illustrates the motion of both configurations in one encounter.
svg.title: Same start. Different motion.
